correctness.rationale: Local overpartition weight factors yield exact joint GF (1) and exact equality GF (3). Eta-product saddle t~pi/(2sqrt n), constrained coefficient transfer via a uniformly untouched sqrt(n)-length block, and a finite-marking conditional analysis establish joint limit and independence. Summing equality local masses with B-tail domination gives literal P(A=B)->1/2. Continuous mapping yields the ratio law. Exhaustive marked-part enumeration n<=11 matches both generating functions; separate partition recurrence and n=100,400,900 tests confirm coefficients; finite tests are not proofs.

value.rationale: Three separately established conventions for the first missing part are compared on a single randomly sampled overpartition. Two have an \(n^{1/4}\) Rayleigh-coupled scale, one remains geometrically tight, and the relation between the former has an exact nonzero 1/2 diagonal coincidence probability. This is a structural coupling and scale-separation statement not obtainable from either marginal alone, relevant for calibrating simultaneous mex statistics; no general numerical novelty claim or routine parameter increment is involved.
